attributes.mechanism: Observable MWCC value-identity/common-subexpression choice, not a missing instruction or unsupported compiler scheduler mode. The numeric stride alone is not enough: sizeof has unsigned type, whereas the original constant multiplication is signed; the two same-valued expressions lead to different sharing at the direct default access. Keeping signed arithmetic recovers the desired scratch homes with ordinary source. Internal compiler algorithms were not reverse-engineered, and this constructive closure does not establish universal reachability for the remaining rules.
